title: Holacracy against how Dinis's agents run: 16 parts

sources_read.mapping: board/team/holacracy.d/public/02-the-mapping.md, read 22 Nov 2026; the match (Strong, Partial, Missing) is holacracy.d's and maestro.d's own judgement, drawn as given; Holacracy constitution v5.0

nodes.label: Constitution, ratified by the founder
nodes.ours: Each repository's rules, the Agent Behaviour Policies (abp@'s files), Dinis's guidance

nodes.label: Role: purpose, domains, accountabilities
nodes.ours: A role file or brief (purpose); the policy grant of paths an agent may write (domains, almost literally); the "owns" lines (accountabilities); "never" lines (limits)

nodes.label: One person fills many roles
nodes.ours: One session runs several roles as sub-agents

nodes.label: One role, several fillers, each with a focus
nodes.ours: Twins: one role on two accounts; the focus is the account

nodes.label: Circle with a purpose
nodes.ours: A project: PrompTugal, SovereignWebsite, AgentiCCells, sgit.ai, the central circle; sub-circles such as a site team

nodes.label: Anchor circle
nodes.note: Partial: its purpose is not yet written

nodes.label: Circle Lead
nodes.ours: Each project's conductor; Dinis for sgit.ai

nodes.label: Circle Rep
nodes.ours: Nothing separate: a conductor carries its own circle's asks up
nodes.note: Missing; holacracy.d takes it where none exists

nodes.label: Secretary
nodes.ours: Status files, debriefs, decision pages, librarian@, historian@
nodes.note: Scattered; holacracy.d keeps the governance record

nodes.label: Tension
nodes.ours: Asks in status files, findings, "never blocked in silence"

nodes.label: Tactical meeting
nodes.ours: Each agent's wake: pull, read, do the next piece, write status, say what blocks

nodes.label: Integrative decision making
nodes.ours: "The owner's recommendation is the default: push it and try it live"; reviewers weigh in

nodes.label: Policies granting or limiting domains
nodes.ours: Agent Behaviour Policies, deny by default

nodes.label: Governance record
nodes.ours: None in one place before 22 November: spread over keys, policies, status files and session lists
nodes.note: Missing; this is the org chart

notes: I only draw; holacracy.d keeps the table.
